verdict.rationale: Whisper ships an official CLI from OpenAI's own GitHub repo. It installs via `pip install -U openai-whisper` and transcribes from the command line with flags for model, language and translation. OpenAI's API docs also show an official `openai audio:transcriptions create` CLI command for hosted transcription. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the official CLI (community reports cover whisper.cpp and Buzz instead), and documented agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable output options.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The following command will transcribe speech in audio files, using the `turbo` model: whisper audio.flac audio.mp3 audio.wav --model turbo
